svg.aria-label: You give Regent one instruction. Regent hands the work to sessions in the right projects, or to coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code, checks in on them while you are away, and brings back only what needs your decision. It reminds you when asked, the sessions it starts run in Smart mode, and it stays quiet when nothing needs you.
